text: Every day, there's a new star.
A week later... nobody remembers them.
The whole world watched Michael Jackson.
Thriller became the best-selling album ever.
So why can't anyone be that famous today?
Back then, there were only a few TV channels for the whole planet.
Now, everyone has their own feed.
Back then, there were only a handful of stars.
Now, thousands of new songs come out every day.
A hit could play for years.
Now, a trend lasts only a few days.
So who is the biggest star right now?
Millions of fans... but never the whole world at once.
Who is the Michael Jackson of your generation? Tell us in the comments.
